info.description: Bridge-agnostic conversation broker for the agent reasoning domain.
info.title: Orchestrator Conversation Broker Host API

get.description: Returns the agent-scoped prompt template for the given key.

post.description: Creates or overwrites the agent-scoped prompt template for the given key.
Upserts a bridge: 200 with the existing row when the given `id` exists, 201 with the new row otherwise.

get.description: Returns conversations sorted by most recently updated, paginated.

post.description: Creates a conversation attached to a bridge. Optionally attaches participants in the same call.

patch.description: Overwrites the description of an existing conversation. Use null to clear it.

post.description: Marks the conversation as concluded immediately, bypassing the swarm timers.

get.description: Returns every message of the conversation in chronological order.

post.description: Persists a message authored by a participant in the conversation. Broker assigns the timestamp.

get.description: Returns every participant attached to the conversation.

post.description: Adds a participant (agent or user) to the conversation.

delete.description: Removes a participant from the conversation.

post.description: Upserts an agent participant by NFT identity: 200 if known, 201 if new; role + ENS from the registry.
Creates a user participant by display name only. No dedup — bridges must cache the returned id.

get.description: Resolves the agent's runtime from the AgentEnsRegistry and returns its cached /.well-known/6022 card.
Resolves the agent's node URL from its ENS url text record in the AgentEnsRegistry.
